fragments.body:
Structural assessment reuses one bounded Git batch reader for blob reads within
an assessment, reducing process creation while retaining path, symlink and byte
limits. The process is closed and reaped at the end of the operation.

Doctor identifies conflicting adoption dates, counts legacy sealed bundles and
names invalid declarations inside stale review profiles. Roadmap checks explain
when no cut criteria exist. Review verification retains selected sealed-evidence
observation warnings, including for completed scopes whose approval is retained.

History checks in quiet mode emit one final verdict when unstaged or untracked
JSONL is tolerated, preserving strict failure and tolerant success exit codes.

Native Homebrew and WinGet verification is deferred to an explicitly dispatched
GitHub Actions round after implementation. It no longer starts automatically
after releases or blocks other implementation work; actual channel support
claims still require successful native evidence.

Release asset parity discovers nested documentation instead of relying on a
manual source list. SBOM fixtures share the verifier's direct dependency parser.
Local verification includes the current CI gates and explicitly identifies fast
mode omissions.

Add explicit, reviewable verdicts for stable POSE usage findings. `pose usage`
and MCP `pose_usage` report adjudicated counts, false-positive rate and
unmatched verdicts beside automatic observations.

Delivery graph failures are reported once with their originating spec instead
of being repeated against unrelated completed specs. Human authority issuer
pins receive format diagnostics, authority claims use their envelope schema,
and excluded lifecycle paths remain portable between checkouts.

Contributor-mode manuals agree that agents request confirmation before staging
local feedback and again before submitting it upstream. Review bundles can seal
a root `.env.example` with its content intact. Package-channel checks inspect
the installed binary in a fresh project instead of the source checkout.
